title: Access to archived records
bodyMd:
Each application is counted once; successful access is measured within the same follow-up window for every application.

| Category | Applications | Successful access |
|---|---:|---:|
| Maps | 60 | 48 |
| Registers | 100 | 65 |
| Photographs | 140 | 119 |
